info.description: Tidepool is one binary with two surfaces: the Talo-compatible game API and the pool/hub operator API. Game routes under /v1/auth, /v1/players, /v1/leaderboards, /v1/saves, /v1/games, /v1/events, /v1/feedback and /v1/socket-tickets are unchanged by the contract. Hub routes (/v1/setup, /v1/pool, /v1/api-keys, /v1/hosts, /v1/connections, /v1/projects, /v1/triggers, /v1/runs, /v1/activity, /v1/chatrooms, /v1/sessions/{session}/relay and /v1/webhooks) return RFC 9457 application/problem+json with a stable code and requestId. See docs/API_CONTRACT.md for what is stable within v1, what may change, and how a breaking change is announced; docs/HUB_API_ERRORS.md lists the error codes.
